chain.description: Filter by blockchain (e.g. 'Ethereum', 'Base', 'Polygon', 'Arbitrum', 'Solana'). Case-insensitive. Omit for all chains.

limit.description: Number of pools to return (1–50, default 20).

min_apy.description: Minimum APY percentage to include (based on 30-day mean). Default 0. E.g. 5 returns pools yielding ≥5% annualized.

min_tvl_usd.description: Minimum Total Value Locked in USD. Default 1000000 ($1M). Lower values include smaller pools with potentially higher (but riskier) yields.

protocol.description: Filter by protocol name (e.g. 'aave-v3', 'uniswap-v3', 'curve', 'lido'). Case-insensitive substring match.

sort_by.description: Sort order: 'apy_30d' (30-day average APY, default and most stable), 'apy_current' (live APY, more volatile), 'tvl' (largest pools first).

stablecoin_only.description: If true, returns only stablecoin pools (no impermanent loss from token price volatility). Default false.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns active DeFi yield farming pools sorted by 30-day average APY. Sourced from DeFiLlama (free, no key). Each pool includes protocol, chain, symbol, TVL, current APY, 30-day mean APY, impermanent-loss risk, and stablecoin flag. Filter by chain, protocol, minimum TVL, minimum APY, or stablecoin-only pools. Use for portfolio yield research, pre-trade DeFi reconnaissance, or capital allocation decisions.
